entries.title: II Chronicles 21:1
segments: The city of David; the hill of Zion,

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:3
segments: Divine grace is not inherited; and no parent can know what will be the state of his children after he is dead.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:4
segments: Slew all his brethren; lest they should rebel against his authority.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:6
segments: Intimate connections with the openly wicked tend to corrupt the heart, debase the character, and ripen the soul for the vengeance of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:10
segments: Libnah; in the south-western part of Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:12
segments:
A writing; it is commonly supposed that Elijah prepared this awful message before his death by God's direction, and left it to be communicated to Jehoram at the proper time; just as he fulfilled the command to anoint Jehu king over Israel and Hazael king over Syria, not in his own person, but by the ministry of others. 
 
The wickedness of the wicked is all known to Jehovah, and in due time he will punish it as it deserves.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:18
segments: The effects of sin are often terrible in this world, and dreadful warnings of the misery which awaits it in the world to come.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:19
segments: No burning; of sweet spices, as a mark of honor.

entries.title: II Chronicles 21:20
segments: Without being desired; the people did not desire that he should live, nor did they mourn his death.
